name: Grade 8 IT Practice: May Week 9 - Portfolio Planning
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: A collection of work that shows learning.
words.example: The portfolio collected the campaign graphic, research, and reflection.

words.definition: Screenshots, pages, or credits that prove portfolio progress.
words.example: The screenshot was evidence that the webpage worked.

words.definition: A planned message that asks people to care or act.
words.example: The campaign focused on using school devices responsibly.

words.definition: Looking for information to answer a question.
words.example: Research helped the student choose facts for the poster.

words.definition: A note showing where information or media came from.
words.example: The source credit was placed under the borrowed image.

words.definition: A plan for pages and content.
words.example: The page plan listed the homepage, research page, and reflection page.

words.definition: Words that ask the reader to do something.
words.example: The call to action asked viewers to organize their files.
